match: application volume manual review rate time to decision
prompt: Show application volume, manual-review rate, and time to decision by product and channel.

results.text: Application volume is now 1,861 after the injected Transportation/CA application, requesting USD 5 million. It has not materially moved the manual-review rate or average hours to decision because it is a single pending application.

sql.command:
SELECT product_name, channel, application_count, manual_review_rate, avg_hours_to_decision, requested_amount_total
FROM aa_credit_operations
WHERE submitted_date > DATE_SUB((SELECT logical_time FROM demo_active_run WHERE singleton_id = 1), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
